mapper.select:
select cs.station_id , cs.station_name , cs.address , cs.latitude , cs.longitude , cs.operator_name , cs.open_time , cs.close_time , cs.station_status , cs.created_at , cs.updated_at , count(c.charger_id) as charger_count , coalesce( sum( case when c.status = '사용가능' then 1 else 0 end ), 0 ) as available_charger_count
from charging_station cs
left join charger c on cs.station_id = c.station_id
where 1 = 1
and ( cs.station_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cs.address like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cs.operator_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
group by cs.station_id , cs.station_name , cs.address , cs.latitude , cs.longitude , cs.operator_name , cs.open_time , cs.close_time , cs.station_status , cs.created_at , cs.updated_at
order by cs.station_id desc

select station_id , station_name , address , latitude , longitude , operator_name , open_time , close_time , station_status , created_at , updated_at from charging_station where station_id = #{stationId}

select charger_id , station_id , charger_name , charger_type , connector_type , charging_speed_kw , price_per_kwh , status , created_at , updated_at from charger where station_id = #{stationId} order by charger_id asc

select cs.station_id , cs.station_name , cs.address , cs.operator_name , cs.station_status , cs.latitude , cs.longitude , count(c.charger_id) as charger_count , coalesce( sum( case when c.status = '사용가능' then 1 else 0 end ), 0 ) as available_charger_count from charging_station cs left join charger c on cs.station_id = c.station_id where 1=1
and ( cs.station_name ilike '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or cs.address ilike '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or cs.operator_name ilike '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
group by cs.station_id , cs.station_name , cs.address , cs.operator_name , cs.station_status , cs.latitude , cs.longitude order by cs.station_id desc

select count(*) from charging_station cs join saved_location sl on sl.member_id = #{memberId} and sl.is_default = true where cs.station_status = '운영중' and ST_DWithin( ST_SetSRID( ST_MakePoint(cs.longitude::double precision, cs.latitude::double precision), 4326 )::geography, sl.location, #{radiusMeter} )

select count(c.charger_id) from charging_station cs join saved_location sl on sl.member_id = #{memberId} and sl.is_default = true join charger c on cs.station_id = c.station_id and c.status = '사용가능' where cs.station_status = '운영중' and ST_DWithin( ST_SetSRID( ST_MakePoint(cs.longitude::double precision, cs.latitude::double precision), 4326 )::geography, sl.location, #{radiusMeter} )

select cs.station_id , cs.station_name , cs.address , cs.operator_name , cs.station_status , cs.image_url , cs.latitude , cs.longitude , count(c.charger_id) as charger_count , coalesce( sum( case when c.status = '사용가능' then 1 else 0 end ), 0 ) as available_charger_count , round( ( ST_Distance( ST_SetSRID( ST_MakePoint(cs.longitude::double precision, cs.latitude::double precision), 4326 )::geography, sl.location ) / 1000 )::numeric, 1 )::double precision as distance_km from charging_station cs join saved_location sl on sl.member_id = #{memberId} and sl.is_default = true left join charger c on cs.station_id = c.station_id where cs.station_status = '운영중' and ST_DWithin( ST_SetSRID( ST_MakePoint(cs.longitude::double precision, cs.latitude::double precision), 4326 )::geography, sl.location, #{radiusMeter} ) group by cs.station_id , cs.station_name , cs.address , cs.operator_name , cs.station_status , cs.image_url , cs.latitude , cs.longitude , sl.location order by distance_km asc , available_charger_count desc , cs.station_id asc limit #{limit}
